title: FACET: Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport in High-Fidelity Fluorescence Microscopy Synthesis
title_zh: FACET：用于高保真荧光显微镜图像合成的高效传输的因子分解非对称条件化方法

paragraphs.en: Fluorescence microscopy reveals where proteins localize, but only a limited number of proteins can be imaged in the same cell; generating these images from amino-acid sequence and the cell’s morphological context enables in silico localization of unimaged proteins. The two conditions, however, play asymmetric roles: morphological context is spatially aligned with the target, whereas sequence is non-spatial and must specify protein-dependent localization within it, with recurring coarse patterns shared across proteins and finer protein-specific variation. Existing generators condition on both jointly, without separating what each explains. We introduce FACET ( Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport ), a probabilistic generative framework that encodes this structure as an explicit inductive bias: sequence semantics are learned from what context leaves unexplained, coarse localization regularities are shared across proteins through a semantic memory, and protein-specific variation is a bounded residual around them. A variance-preserving state projection further lets FACET perform continuous stochastic transport through a pretrained diffusion predictor with minimal parameter overhead. On held-out proteins, FACET improves spatial overlap by 34.3% on the Human Protein Atlas and 14.0% on OpenCell over a backbone-matched baseline, and reduces FID by 27.2% and 46.5%, respectively, with 75% fewer network evaluations. It also substantially improves protein-association structure recovery and yields better-calibrated predictions, while detailed ablations show complementary contributions from its design choices. These results identify factorized asymmetric conditioning, rather than generator capacity alone, as a key lever for high-fidelity, efficient, and biologically meaningful cellular image synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 荧光显微镜可以揭示蛋白质的定位，但同一细胞中只能对有限数量的蛋白质进行成像；通过氨基酸序列和细胞的形态学背景生成这些图像，使得未成像的蛋白质能够在虚拟环境中实现定位。 然而，这两种条件发挥着不对称的作用：形态学背景在空间上与目标对齐，而序列则不具备空间性，必须在其中指定依赖于蛋白质的定位方式，其中重复出现的粗略模式为多种蛋白质所共享，而更精细的变化则具有蛋白质特异性。 现有的生成模型将两者作为联合条件输入，而未区分各自所解释的内容。 我们提出了 FACET（用于高效传输的因子化不对称条件建模），这是一种概率性生成框架，它将上述结构编码为显式的归纳偏置：序列语义从背景中未解释的部分中学习，粗略的定位规律通过语义记忆在蛋白质间共享，而蛋白质特异性变化则是围绕这些规律的有界残差。 一种保持方差的态投影方法还使 FACET 能够以最小的参数开销，通过预训练的扩散预测器执行连续的随机传输。 在预留的蛋白质数据集上，FACET 与基线模型相比，在 Human Protein Atlas 上的空间重叠度提升了 34.3%，在 OpenCell 上提升了 14.0%；同时 FID 分别降低了 27.2% 和 46.5%，且网络评估次数减少了 75%。 它还显著改进了蛋白质相互作用结构的恢复效果，并生成了校准更准确的预测结果；详细的消融分析表明，其设计选择具有互补性的贡献。 这些结果表明，因子化不对称条件建模——而非仅靠生成模型的能力——是实现高保真、高效且具有生物学意义的细胞图像合成的关键手段。

paragraphs.en: Protein subcellular localization is a spatial phenotype that links molecular identity to cellular function and is directly observed through fluorescence microscopy ( Thul et al., 2017 ) . Recent sequence-to-image models generate these phenotypes from protein sequence and cellular context ( Khwaja et al., 2023 ; Zheng and Huang, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Yet these conditions play fundamentally different roles: context is spatially aligned with the target, whereas sequence is non-spatial and must specify protein-dependent localization semantics within that context. The conditions are therefore asymmetric in representation and explanatory role, rather than in biological importance.
paragraphs.zh: 蛋白质的亚细胞定位是一种空间表型，它将分子身份与细胞功能联系起来，并可通过荧光显微镜直接观察到（Thul 等，2017）。 近期的序列到图像模型能够根据蛋白质序列和细胞背景生成这些表型（Khwaja 等，2023；Zheng 和 Huang，2025；Zhang 等，2025）。 然而，这些条件在作用上存在根本差异：背景与目标在空间上对齐，而序列则不具备空间性，必须在该背景中明确指定依赖于蛋白质的定位语义。 因此，这些条件在表示和解释作用上是不对称的，而非在生物学重要性上不对称。

paragraphs.en: Our key insight is that protein localization is inherently context-relative and hierarchically organized, spanning from recurring regularities shared across proteins to finer protein-specific variation. This motivates three coupled modeling requirements. First, sequence representations should capture localization information beyond what context already explains: even a linear map from context features explains over a third of held-out target-feature variance (Appendix B.2 ), a lower bound on the redundancy that sequence semantics need not re-encode. Second, recurring coarse localization regularities should be shared across proteins rather than relearned independently. Third, finer protein-specific variation should remain distinct from both the shared regularities and image stochasticity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心见解是，蛋白质的定位本质上具有情境相对性和层次性，既包括跨蛋白质重复出现的规律性特征，也包括更精细的蛋白质特异性变异。 这催生了三个相互关联的建模需求。 首先，序列表示应捕捉到超出情境信息所能解释的定位信息：即便仅通过从情境特征到目标特征的线性映射，也能解释保留测试集中目标特征方差的三分之一以上（附录 B.2），而这是序列语义无需重新编码的冗余信息的下限。 其次，重复出现的粗粒度定位规律应在不同蛋白质间共享，而非独立重新学习。 第三，更精细的蛋白质特异性变异应与共享规律以及图像的随机性保持区分。

paragraphs.en: Principled latent-variable formulation with efficient transport. We derive a conditional latent-variable model whose evidence lower bound decomposes into coarse-semantic, protein-specific, and transport terms, each optimized blockwise by our staged objective, and establish an exact variance-preserving state projection that enables continuous stochastic transport through a pretrained finite-schedule latent diffusion predictor with under 0.6% parameter overhead.

Controlled ablations isolate the contributions of its semantic, hierarchical, and transport components, while further analyses show cross-dataset transfer, consistent gains across multi-channel context compositions, stronger recovery of protein-association patterns, and improved predictive calibration.

paragraphs.en: Sequence-conditioned localization imaging has progressed from bidirectional sequence-image transformers ( Khwaja et al., 2023 ) and sequence- and landmark-conditioned prediction ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) to diffusion conditioned on sequence and morphology ( Zheng and Huang, 2025 ) ; concurrent preprints scale identity-conditioned generation to 12,800 human proteins ( Sun et al., 2026 ) or adopt autoregressive generation ( Kambhampati et al., 2026 ) . These works mainly advance the image model; FACET instead factorizes sequence semantics and cellular context within a conditional generator, complementing any pretrained variance-preserving backbone, so we compare in a backbone-matched setting. Extended discussion on related work is provided in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: We study conditional protein spatial-phenotype generation, where a target image Y Y is generated from protein sequence S S and cellular morphology context C C . While C C specifies the spatial environment, sequence-dependent localization spans coarse regularities shared across proteins and finer protein-specific variation. We represent this hierarchy with a reusable semantic memory ℳ = { V r } r = 1 K \mathcal{M}=\{V_{r}\}_{r=1}^{K} of coarse localization prototypes, a prototype-valued latent R R for sequence-dependent prototype selection, and a continuous residual δ ​ z S \delta z_{S} for variation beyond the prototypes. This factorization organizes coarse and fine sequence variation while retaining direct conditioning on both S S and C C in the image model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究条件性蛋白质空间表型生成，其中目标图像 Y 由蛋白质序列 S 和细胞形态上下文 C 共同生成。 虽然 C 定义了空间环境，但序列依赖的定位则涵盖了蛋白质间共有的粗略规律以及更精细的蛋白质特异性变异。 我们通过一个可重用的语义记忆 ℳ = { V r } r = 1 K \mathcal{M}=\{V_{r}\}_{r=1}^{K} 来表示这种层次结构，该记忆包含粗略定位原型、用于序列依赖原型选择的原型值潜在变量 R，以及用于表示超出原型范围的变异的连续残差 δ z S \delta z_{S}。 这种因子分解将粗略和精细的序列变异进行了组织，同时保留了图像模型中对 S 和 C 的直接条件约束。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate FACET on protein-held-out HPA and OpenCell benchmarks. HPA contains 696 test images from 97 held-out proteins and provides nucleus, endoplasmic-reticulum, and microtubule context channels; we evaluate four compositions of these channels. OpenCell uses nucleus-only context and evaluates both HPA-adapted FACET , which transfers the HPA-trained FACET modules, and OpenCell-adapted FACET , which fits these modules on OpenCell data. paragraphs.en: We compare against two published generators, CELL-E2 ( Khwaja et al., 2023 ) and CELL-Diff ( Zheng and Huang, 2025 ) , as well as several backbone-matched internal baselines: ε \varepsilon -adaptation-only control, pathway and inference-time memory ablations, adaptation and initialization variants, and sampler variants across NFE budgets. CELL-Diff is, to our knowledge, the only public sequence-conditioned latent diffusion model with checkpoints for both benchmarks (Appendix E.3 ). In all FACET variants, the VAE and ESM2 remain frozen; the ε \varepsilon -predictor is either kept frozen or, in variants with backbone LoRA, adapted only through the introduced LoRA updates.

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate protein-conditioned spatial-phenotype generation on the held-out HPA test set. Tab. 1 summarizes the comparison across image-quality metrics and sampling cost. FACET achieves the best value on all six reported image-quality metrics while requiring only 25 network function evaluations per image, compared with 100 for CELL-Diff. paragraphs.en: To assess whether generated images preserve protein-association patterns, we adapt the localization-matched evaluation of Sun et al. (2026) . We use STRING ( Szklarczyk et al., 2023 ) , a database of known and predicted functional protein associations, solely to obtain external evaluation labels. We generate the 97 proteins in the HPA test split under eight fixed cellular contexts, using matched context and noise seeds across systems. For each protein pair, we compute within-cell Pearson similarity after removing the per-cell mean image across proteins. This suppresses similarity caused by shared cellular morphology. We then compare STRING-associated pairs with non-associated pairs that share at least one annotated compartment. STRING labels are used only for evaluation and do not enter model training or conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估生成的图像是否保留了蛋白质相互作用模式，我们采用了 Sun 等人（2026）提出的局部化匹配评估方法。 我们仅使用 STRING（Szklarczyk 等人，2023）——一个包含已知和预测的功能性蛋白质相互作用数据库——来获取外部评估标签。 我们在八个固定的细胞背景下生成了 HPA 测试划分中的 97 种蛋白质，并在各系统中使用了匹配的上下文和噪声种子。 对于每一对蛋白质，我们在去除每个细胞中所有蛋白质的平均图像后，计算了细胞内的皮尔逊相似性。 这样可以抑制由共享的细胞形态学特征所导致的相似性。 接着，我们将 STRING 标记的相互作用对与至少共享一个已注释细胞区室的非相互作用对进行比较。 STRING 标签仅用于评估，不会进入模型训练或条件设置环节。

paragraphs.en: To isolate the contribution of the learned semantic memory at inference, we keep all other FACET components fixed and replace the learned memory with either the uniform mean of the prototypes or a zero memory. As shown in Tab. 7 , the unmodified learned memory achieves the highest IoU cont \mathrm{IoU}_{\mathrm{cont}} of 0.3328 0.3328 . Replacing it with the uniform prototype mean or zero memory reduces performance to 0.2820 0.2820 and 0.3014 0.3014 , respectively. Zero memory degrades less because the standardized PCA space is centered, so zero approximates the frequency-weighted prototype average, whereas the uniform mean overweights rare localization categories and injects a protein-agnostic bias. This result indicates that FACET benefits from the protein-conditioned organization of the learned memory rather than from memory injection alone.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate calibration and overall probabilistic forecast quality, we report ECE, MCE, and the Brier score using 16 samples per input. We follow the post-hoc temperature-scaling procedure of Guo et al. (2017) , fitting the temperature on a protein-disjoint validation partition and keeping it fixed for test evaluation. As shown in Tab. 9 , FACET substantially improves all three calibration measures: ECE decreases from 0.21501 0.21501 to 0.05442 0.05442 , MCE from 0.24886 0.24886 to 0.14850 0.14850 , and Brier score from 0.23372 0.23372 to 0.19915 0.19915 . These results indicate that FACET produces more reliable predictive foreground probabilities. This provides additional evidence that the factorized stochastic predictor is not only accurate but also better calibrated under repeated sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估校准性和整体概率预测质量，我们使用每个输入 16 个样本报告了 ECE、MCE 和布雷尔分数。我们遵循 Guo 等人（2017）提出的事后温度缩放方法，在蛋白质互不重叠的验证分区上拟合温度，并在测试评估中保持该温度不变。如表 9 所示，FACET 显著提升了所有三项校准指标：ECE 从 0.21501 降至 0.05442，MCE 从 0.24886 降至 0.14850，布雷尔分数则从 0.23372 降至 0.19915。这些结果表明，FACET 能够生成更可靠的预测前景概率。这进一步证明，分解式随机预测模型不仅准确，而且在重复采样下也具有更好的校准性。

paragraphs.en: We introduced FACET , a factorized probabilistic framework that turns the asymmetric, hierarchical structure of protein localization into an explicit inductive bias atop a pretrained diffusion prior. On unseen proteins across two benchmarks, it substantially improves spatial and distributional fidelity at a fraction of the sampling cost, while improving protein-association recovery and calibration. With the backbone held fixed, these gains are attributable to FACET ’s factorized probabilistic formulation rather than generator capacity, making it complementary to stronger backbones and a template for conditional generation whenever inputs differ in spatial alignment and explanatory power.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 FACET，一种因子分解的概率框架，它将蛋白质定位的非对称层级结构转化为预训练扩散先验之上的显式归纳偏置。 在两个基准测试中，对于未见过的蛋白质，FACET 以极低的采样成本显著提升了空间与分布保真度，同时改善了蛋白质关联的恢复与校准效果。 在保持主干模型不变的情况下，这些改进可归因于 FACET 的因子分解概率公式，而非生成器的容量；因此，FACET 能够与更强大的主干模型互补，并为输入在空间对齐和解释力上存在差异时的条件生成提供模板。

paragraphs.en: FACET inherits its backbone’s finite noise schedule, which bounds the usable sampling steps; continuous-time variance-preserving backbones lift this directly. Extending FACET to 3D and time-lapse imaging, multi-protein generation, and perturbations are natural next steps toward in silico spatial proteomics.
paragraphs.zh: FACET 继承其骨干网络的有限噪声调度，这限制了可用的采样步数；而连续时间方差保持的骨干网络则直接解决了这一问题。 将 FACET 扩展到三维和时间序列成像、多蛋白生成以及扰动分析，是迈向虚拟空间蛋白质组学的自然后续步骤。

paragraphs.en: Joint multimodal training can under-utilize one modality even when all inputs are informative. Gradient Blending identified different optimization and generalization rates across modalities ( Wang et al., 2020 ) , gradient modulation and prototype rebalancing mitigate modality imbalance ( Peng et al., 2022 ; Fan et al., 2023 ) , and theoretical work shows that joint gradient descent can produce modality competition in simplified settings ( Huang et al., 2022 ) . These works primarily study discriminative fusion. FACET addresses a distinct generative setting in which conditions differ in representation, spatial alignment, and explanatory role, assigning them distinct but coupled generative roles rather than rebalancing their contributions to a shared discriminative objective.
paragraphs.zh: 联合多模态训练可能会使其中一种模态未被充分利用，即使所有输入都具有信息价值。 Gradient Blending 发现不同模态的优化和泛化速率存在差异（Wang 等，2020）；梯度调制和原型再平衡可以缓解模态失衡问题（Peng 等，2022；Fan 等，2023）；理论研究表明，在简化设定中，联合梯度下降可能导致模态竞争（Huang 等，2022）。 这些研究主要关注判别式融合。 FACET 解决了一种不同的生成式设定：其中各条件的表示形式、空间对齐和解释作用各不相同，该方法为它们分配了独特但相互耦合的生成角色，而非重新平衡它们对共享判别目标的贡献。

paragraphs.en: Protein-localization image generation has been approached with bidirectional sequence–image transformers conditioned on nucleus context ( Khwaja et al., 2023 ) , sequence- and landmark-conditioned image prediction ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , diffusion conditioned on protein sequence and cellular morphology ( Zheng and Huang, 2025 ) , conditional diffusion using cellular landmarks and learned protein identities ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , and recent channel-adaptive autoregressive generation from sequence and cellular landmarks ( Kambhampati et al., 2026 ) . Perturbation-conditioned diffusion models instead predict morphology from transcriptomic or perturbation information ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . HPA ( Thul et al., 2017 ) and OpenCell ( Cho et al., 2022 ) provide complementary protein-localization microscopy resources. Our focus is not a new image backbone, but how sequence-dependent localization and cellular morphology are structured within a probabilistic conditional generator, including an architecture-controlled comparison to CELL-Diff.
paragraphs.zh: 蛋白质定位图像生成已采用多种方法，包括基于核上下文的双向序列-图像变换器（Khwaja 等人，2023）、基于序列和地标点的图像预测（Zhang 等人，2025）、基于蛋白质序列和细胞形态的扩散模型（Zheng 和 Huang，2025）、结合细胞地标点和已学习蛋白质身份的有条件扩散模型（Sun 等人，2026），以及近期基于序列和细胞地标点的通道自适应自回归生成方法（Kambhampati 等人，2026）。 扰动条件扩散模型则通过转录组或扰动信息预测细胞形态（Wang 等人，2025）。 HPA（Thul 等人，2017）和 OpenCell（Cho 等人，2022）提供了互补的蛋白质定位显微图像资源。 我们的重点并非提出新的图像生成基础模型，而是研究序列依赖的定位特征与细胞形态如何在概率性条件生成器中结构化，包括通过架构控制与 CELL-Diff 进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models construct generative processes through progressive corruption and denoising, latent diffusion moves this process to a compressed image representation ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ; Mahbub et al., 2025 ; Ellington et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Zou et al., 2024 ) . Flow matching learns continuous vector fields from tractable conditional paths ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) , rectified flow emphasizes direct transport paths ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , stochastic interpolants unify deterministic and stochastic transports ( Albergo et al., 2025 ) , and optimal-transport couplings can improve flow training ( Tong et al., 2024 ) . Recent methods bridge pretrained diffusion and flow models through interpolant and timestep alignment ( Schusterbauer et al., 2025 ) , or accelerate few-step generation by learning stochastic-interpolant schedules ( Min et al., 2026 ) . FACET uses stochastic flow matching as its transport component and introduces an explicit variance-preserving state projection that makes continuous transport states compatible with a pretrained finite-schedule diffusion predictor.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型通过渐进式破坏和去噪构建生成过程，而潜在扩散则将这一过程转移到一个压缩的图像表示中（Rombach 等，2022；Ho 等，2020；Song 等，2020；Song 等，2021；Mahbub 等，2025；Ellington 等，2024；Sun 等，2024；Zou 等，2024）。 流匹配从可处理的条件路径中学习连续向量场（Lipman 等，2023），修正流强调直接的传输路径（Liu 等，2023），随机插值器统一了确定性和随机性传输（Albergo 等，2025），而最优传输耦合则能够改进流训练（Tong 等，2024）。 近期方法通过插值器和时间步对齐将预训练的扩散模型与流模型连接起来（Schusterbauer 等，2025），或通过学习随机插值器调度来加速少步生成（Min 等，2026）。 FACET 使用随机流匹配作为其传输组件，并引入了一种显式的方差保持状态投影，使连续传输状态能够与预训练的有限调度扩散预测器兼容。

paragraphs.en: Variational autoencoders provide amortized latent-variable inference, while hierarchical variants show how multiple stochastic levels can represent different factors of variation ( Kingma and Welling, 2014 ; Sønderby et al., 2016 ; Mahbub et al., 2026a ; Mahbub et al., 2026b ) . Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) provides a general mechanism for conditional affine modulation ( Perez et al., 2018 ) . Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) trains additive low-rank weight updates while retaining pretrained parameters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , and ControlNet demonstrates parameter-efficient conditioning around a strong pretrained image prior ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) . FACET uses variational residual inference, FiLM, and LoRA within an asymmetric factorization that assigns cellular context, coarse sequence semantics, fine protein-specific variation, and image stochasticity distinct but coupled generative roles.

paragraphs.en: Shortcut learning concerns reliance on easy predictive cues ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ) , batch effects arise from acquisition or processing variation ( Leek et al., 2010 ) , and domain-adversarial learning suppresses domain-identifying information to obtain invariance ( Ganin et al., 2016 ) . FACET differs from these objectives: cellular morphology is a scientifically meaningful conditioning variable and remains directly available to the generator rather than being treated as a nuisance signal to remove. Context residualization is applied only when constructing the semantic memory, encouraging sequence semantics to capture localization information beyond what context already explains rather than enforcing invariance to context. The objective remains high-fidelity conditional generation from both sequence and cellular context, not removal of either condition.
paragraphs.zh: 捷径学习涉及对易于预测的线索的依赖（Geirhos 等人，2020），批次效应源于获取或处理过程中的差异（Leek 等人，2010），而领域对抗性学习则通过抑制用于识别领域的信息来获得不变性（Ganin 等人，2016）。 FACET 与这些目标有所不同：细胞形态学是一个具有科学意义的条件变量，并且可以直接供生成器使用，而不是被当作需要去除的干扰信号。 上下文残差化仅在构建语义记忆时应用，从而促使序列语义捕捉到超出上下文已有解释的定位信息，而非强制实现相对于上下文的不变性。 该目标仍然是从序列和细胞上下文中进行高保真条件生成，而不是移除任一条件。

paragraphs.en: FACET employs residual operations at four levels: context-residualized target features, a continuous semantic residual around the coarse memory, a residual correction to the pretrained noise estimate, and a correction to the base velocity field. These operations serve distinct purposes within the factorized probabilistic model. In particular, the deployed semantic state z S = m S + δ ​ z S z_{S}=m_{S}+\delta z_{S} is additive, but the conditional generator is not restricted to an additive decomposition of independent context and sequence functions. For example, sequential FiLM modulation introduces multiplicative interactions through the product ( 1 + γ S ​ ( z S ) ) ⊙ ( 1 + γ C ​ ( z C ) ) (1+\gamma_{S}(z_{S}))\odot(1+\gamma_{C}(z_{C})) . Moreover, the base velocity v L v_{L} is itself conditioned jointly on S S and C C , and the composed velocity v Θ = v L + g ⁡ ( τ ) ​ Δ ​ v v_{\Theta}=v_{L}+g(\tau)\Delta v is integrated along an evolving stochastic trajectory, so additive velocity composition does not imply additive decomposition of the generated image.
paragraphs.zh: FACET 在四个层级上采用了残差操作：上下文残差化的目标特征、围绕粗略记忆的连续语义残差、对预训练噪声估计的残差修正，以及对基础速度场的修正。 这些操作在因子分解的概率模型中各自承担着不同的作用。 具体而言，所部署的语义状态 z S = m S + δ ​ z S z_{S}=m_{S}+\delta z_{S} 是加性的，但条件生成器并不局限于对独立上下文和序列函数进行加性分解。 例如，顺序 FiLM 调制通过乘积 ( 1 + γ S ​ ( z S ) ) ⊙ ( 1 + γ C ​ ( z C ) ) (1+\gamma_{S}(z_{S}))\odot(1+\gamma_{C}(z_{C})) 引入了乘法相互作用。 此外，基础速度 v L v_{L} 本身是联合条件于 S S 和 C C 的，而合成的速度 v Θ = v L + g ⁡ ( τ ) ​ Δ ​ v v_{\Theta}=v_{L}+g(\tau)\Delta v 是沿着一条演化的随机轨迹进行积分的，因此加性速度组合并不意味着生成图像的加性分解。

paragraphs.en: The released HPA training set contains 87,763 stored images from 12,732 proteins and the test split contains 720 stored images from 100 proteins 1 1 1 https://virtualcellmodels.cziscience.com/dataset/hpa-subcellular-section . Following Zheng and Huang (2025) , we use a maximum tokenized sequence length of 2048. This filtering removes 24 images from three proteins, yielding the 696-image, 97-protein evaluation set used throughout the paper. The longest retained sequence has 1938 residues, whereas the shortest excluded sequence has 2157 residues; therefore, the filtering boundary does not remove sequences close to the cutoff. During FACET module adaptation and semantic memory construct, we use a random subset of the HPA training split, formed by adding whole proteins in a fixed random order until an image budget is reached and keeping every image of each selected protein. This yields 24,001 images from 3,491 of the 12,732 training proteins ( ≈ \approx 27% of training images); the pretrained backbone, in contrast, was trained on the full split. A protein-disjoint 10% of this pool (349 proteins, 2,467 images) forms a validation split that is excluded from every fit, is used only for hyperparameter tuning, and never overlaps the test proteins. Of the pool, 3,007 proteins carry a UniProt localization annotation; the 2,704 of them outside the validation split define the prototypes. paragraphs.en: We instantiate FACET on CELL-Diff because, to our knowledge, it is the only publicly available sequence-conditioned latent diffusion model for this task with released checkpoints for both HPA and OpenCell. paragraphs.zh: 我们在 CELL-Diff 上实例化了 FACET，因为据我们所知，这是目前唯一公开可用的、适用于该任务的序列条件潜在扩散模型，并且已为 HPA 和 OpenCell 发布了检查点。 其他近期方法，如 CELL-E2（Khwaja 等，2023）和 Vermeer（Kambhampati 等，2026），属于自回归模型；PUPS（Zhang 等，2025）是一种确定性单细胞修复模型，其分布度量和基于采样的校准尚未定义；而 ProtiCelli（Sun 等，2026）则是基于固定词汇表中的蛋白质身份而非蛋白质序列进行条件建模的，因此无法在训练数据中未包含的蛋白质上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Following the multiscale SSIM formulation of Wang et al. (2003) and the fluorescence-image evaluation protocol of Sun et al. (2026) , we compute five-scale MS-SSIM on images normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , using an 11 × 11 11\times 11 uniform window and 2 × 2 2\times 2 average pooling between scales. At scales 1-4, the SSIM map is spatially averaged before combining the scales. The same implementation is used for all methods before protein-level macro aggregation.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Wang 等人（2003）提出的多尺度 SSIM 公式以及 Sun 等人（2026）提出的荧光图像评估协议，我们对归一化到 [0,1] 的图像计算五尺度的 MS-SSIM，使用 11×11 均匀窗口，并在不同尺度之间进行 2×2 平均池化。在尺度 1-4 中，在合并各尺度之前，先对 SSIM 图进行空间平均。在所有方法中，在蛋白质层面的宏观聚合之前均使用相同的实现方式。

paragraphs.en: We quantify texture similarity using six Haralick descriptors (contrast, dissimilarity, homogeneity, energy, correlation, and angular second moment) computed from gray-level co-occurrence matrices at a unit pixel offset and four orientations, following Haralick et al. (1973) . We average each descriptor over orientations and define texture agreement as the mean of the corresponding per-feature relative similarities between real and generated images ( Sun et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用六种 Haralick 描述符（对比度、异质性、均匀性、能量、相关性和角二阶矩）来量化纹理相似性。这些描述符基于灰度级共现矩阵，在单位像素偏移和四种方向上计算得出，遵循 Haralick 等人（1973）的方法。 我们对每个描述符在所有方向上的值取平均，并将纹理一致性定义为真实图像与生成图像之间各特征相对相似性的平均值（Sun 等人，2026）。
